## Keep the route meaningful

Localized URLs help readers and search engines understand which version they are seeing. The page language, canonical URL, alternate links, and content should agree.

Translate the important moments first: signing in, recovering an account, making a payment, and understanding an error. Good localization makes those moments feel considered rather than improvised.
